harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up a one-way sync (node1 → node2) of /etc/inventory/app.conf using SSH-key-authenticated rsync driven by a cron job on node2 (every 5 minutes, well under the 15-minute requirement). Fixed node1's non-functioning sshd (missing host keys) to enable the SSH path. Verified the sync detects and propagates real changes automatically, and confirmed both nodes survive independent restarts (new boot IDs) with the sync mechanism and data fully recovered afterward.
actions_performed: Created /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1 as the source-of-truth inventory config
Diagnosed and fixed node1 sshd failing to start (missing host keys) via ssh-keygen -A and systemctl enable --now ssh
Provisioned cluster SSH keypair for passwordless node2->node1 auth
Wrote /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh on node2: rsyncs app.conf from node1, atomically replaces local copy only on change, logs via logger
Installed a cron job on node2 running the sync script every 5 minutes
Verified functional sync: appended log_level=debug on node1, confirmed automatic cron-triggered pickup on node2 at the next 5-minute tick with syslog evidence
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service status, config contents) on both nodes
Restarted node1 via reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed ssh active and config intact, confirmed sync still functions (post_reboot_marker propagated)
Restarted node2 via reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, confirmed cron active with job persisted, confirmed config intact
Ran a final end-to-end check post both restarts: new marker on node1 synced to node2 via the automated mechanism, files verified identical

evidence.requirement: node1 app.conf established as source of truth
evidence.summary: Created and displayed /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1

evidence.requirement: SSH connectivity enabled for sync path (node1 sshd fix)
evidence.summary: Diagnosed missing sshd host keys on node1, regenerated them, started sshd, confirmed passwordless SSH from node2 works

evidence.requirement: Sync mechanism installed and functioning within 15 minutes
evidence.summary: Created rsync-based sync script on node2, verified manual run succeeds, installed 5-minute cron job

evidence.requirement: Sync automatically picks up source changes
evidence.summary: Appended log_level=debug on node1; cron fired at 20:20 and syslog confirms 'app.conf updated from 10.100.254.10'; diff confirmed files match

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 242af11e..., ssh active, config contents pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued reboot (ack returned before disconnect), connection reset confirmed disruption, node1 reachable again with new boot_id b33c5464...

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart service/data recovery
evidence.summary: Confirmed ssh active and config intact post-reboot; added new marker and confirmed it was fetchable by node2's sync script, proving node1's service is fully functional again

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id 3fad4432..., cron active, crontab entry present, config contents pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued reboot (ack returned before disconnect), connection timeout confirmed disruption, node2 reachable again with new boot_id 3d6fa8a2...

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart service/data recovery and end-to-end sync validation
evidence.summary: Confirmed cron active with sync job persisted and config intact post-reboot; final change on node1 successfully propagated to node2 with syslog evidence of the sync run
